player_prompt.intro:
Wena uMdlali {player_id} emdlweni we-Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; wena ubona ikhadi leyoqembu.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kule round, {max_rounds} round(s) yonke.
- Imikhiqizo yalowo: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ingumahluko omancane <= ichip count yakho.)
- Ikadi eliphezulu elingenwelekezi lishaya ipoti kulomculo.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Nika malunga kwa bracketed action emibili, k.b. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', noma '[fold]'.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Kute lokumele umshayele; ungaba [check] esikhundleni saloko.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Sebentisa [bet X] kuvula; kute kubheja lokungaphakanyiswa.

message.showdown_tie: Kucocisana: bobabili {card}. Imphandze lehlukanisiwe  ngamunye utfola {split} .

outcome.draw: Emachips lalinganako ngemuva kwato tonkhe tigamu.
